Sun, warm water, endless sandy beaches, spectacular natural wonders … Brazil never fails to charm its visitors.</span></h6>

<h1><span class="palette-2"><em>Taiba Kitesurf Spots</em></span></h1>
</div></div><div  class="tatsu-module tatsu-inline-text clearfix tatsu-B14BI4JH2u   tatsu-animate" data-animation="fadeInUp" data-animation-delay="200" ><style></style><div class="tatsu-inline-text-inner tatsu-align-center">
<h6 style="text-align: justify;"><span class="palette-2">Taiba kite conditions are just perfect. Thanks to the annual trade winds, there are almost 7 months of steady wind conditions (ranging from 18 to 32 knots), from July to January. <h1><span class="palette-2"><em>Kiteschool</em></span></h1>
</div></div><div  class="tatsu-module tatsu-inline-text clearfix tatsu-BJXGm7kt3O   tatsu-animate" data-animation="fadeInUp" data-animation-delay="200" ><style></style><div class="tatsu-inline-text-inner tatsu-align-center">
<p style="text-align: justify;"><span class="palette-2">Our goal is that you can actually practice independently without us and feel ready to go on the spot without us.Teaching in shallow water ensures a fast and safe teaching. We make sure that you master the onshore manipulations to quickly gain real autonomy. The development of radio pedagogy is set up for you, in order to have a clear and precise teaching. Your monitor will be 100% with you! By using the radio, we are gradually making you autonomous without you noticing. Whenever you have assimilated a skill, a gesture, a technique, the instructor reduces his instructions until you fly on your own. Most trainees seek autonomY. We want to put our trainees in confidence so that after a few days of teaching, they become kitesurfers. We teach you to share kitesurf culture with youwhich will allow you to choose, your site of practice correctly and your material, so that it is adapted to the conditions of the day. We wish to contaminate you with this delicious virus which is kitesurf.In general, it is accepted that 10 to 30 hours of sailing after an internship are necessary to correctly acquire the technique of upwelling.</span></p>
</div></div><div  class="tatsu-module tatsu-normal-button tatsu-button-wrap   tatsu-HkOGQX1t3d button-scale  "><a class="tatsu-shortcode smallbtn tatsu-button left-icon rounded  tatsu-animate  bg-animation-none  " href="https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=5585991431583" style= "" data-animation="fadeInUp" data-animation-delay="200"  aria-label="Book your course !" data-gdpr-atts={} target="_blank"><i class="tatsu-icon icon-icon_chat"></i>Book your course !</a><style></style></div></div></div><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image-wrap"><div class = "tatsu-column-bg-image" ></div></div></div><style></style></div><div  class="tatsu-column  tatsu-column-no-bg tatsu-one-half tatsu-column-align-top tatsu-column-image-none tatsu-column-effect-none  tatsu-SyEMXQyFnO"  data-parallax-speed="0" style=""><div class="tatsu-column-inner " ><div class="tatsu-column-pad-wrap"><div class="tatsu-column-pad" ><div  class = " tatsu-r1HfmQJKh_ accordion-wrap oshine-module tatsu-animate" data-animation="fadeInUp" data-animation-delay="200" ><style></style><div class = "accordion" data-collapsed="0"><h3 class="accordion-head no-bg tatsu-SkLz7X1t2O" style="">Beginners<style></style></h3><div>
<h6 style="text-align: justify;"><span style="color: #4a4a4a;">FROM INITIATION TO AUTONOMY, SEVERAL FORMULAS WILL MAKE YOU AN AUTONOMOUS RIDER, WHATEVER YOUR BACKGROUND. </span><span style="color: #4a4a4a;">THE TEACHING PROVIDED DURING OUR COURSES WILL ALLOW YOU TO ASSIMILATE ONE BY ONE THE DIFFERENT STAGES OF OUR EDUCATIONAL AND SECURITY CONTENT. YOU WILL LEARN TO CONTROL YOUR MARINE WING (KITESURF KITE). YOU WILL VALIDATE YOUR PILOTING ON LAND BY SWIMMING AT SEA. YOU WILL FOCUS ON THE REALIZATION OF THE WATERSTART, AND THE FIRST GLIDES, PULLING YOUR EDGES TO THE RIGHT AND TO THE LEFT. IN ANY CASE, YOU WILL EVOLVE AT YOUR OWN PACE TOWARDS A PRACTICE OF AUTONOMOUS AND SAFE KITESURFING, IN ORDER TO ACQUIRE AN INDEPENDENT BEGINNER LEVEL OF PRACTICE.</span></h6>
</div><h3 class="accordion-head no-bg tatsu-rJvfmXyKnu" style="">Intermediate & Advanced<style></style></h3><div>
<h6 style="text-align: justify;"><span style="color: #4a4a4a;">You want to improve your level, become more experienced and learn more about kitesurfing! Learn to master the basic techniques to jump and unlock new maneuvers! Your instructor will introduce you to different techniques to achieve your result. Theoretical topics will include how to better assess the sailing space, kitesurf safety and more details on how to adjust your kite.</span> <span style="color: #4a4a4a;">Advanced kitesurfing courses are designed for fully autonomous people, who have the ability to easily navigate the water. You have to be able to go at all speeds. The instructor will be kiting with you or on the ground, according to the instruction. You use your own equipment.</span></h6>
